note: Grounded repaint v3 2026-10-21: one coherent attic kitchen, single tiled floor; everyone stands, sits on a stool/chair or works at a real oven, stove, table or grill at true scale; the stingray lives in a seafood tank; nothing floating, no rows. Feminine words left of the roof post, masculine right. Only exit: the stairwell going DOWN to the main kitchen (an upper floor never leads straight outside). Skylights are not exits. | 2026-10-22 s04 pkg2: ingredient/gastronomique boxes re-cut and the gastronomique label moved under its plate (no overlap); flat hooks for ingredient, vanille, salsa, barbecue rewritten and rated o. 11 items is a gate-12 warning (not a fail). Vanilla pod repainted locally (the old one read as a dark stick with a metal tip).

items.label: la purée
items.scene: A grey stingray in the kitchen tank pulls a disgusted face, 'PEW!' (pew-RAY), at the bowl of creamy MASHED POTATO set down beside its glass.

items.label: la moutarde
items.scene: A 'MOO' TART (moo-TARD): a smiling cow face piped on a tart covered in yellow MUSTARD, its mouth open in a big moo.

items.label: la vanille
items.scene: A girl on a stool holds a long dark VANILLA pod (vah-NEEY) under her nose like a moustache and breathes in its sweet smell: 'va-NEE-yuh!'

items.label: la salsa
items.scene: A bowl of chunky red SALSA (sahl-SAH) waits on its stool beside a pair of maracas, ready to dance the SALSA.

items.label: la cuisson
items.scene: A quizmaster in a bow tie turns his quiz hourglass at the brick oven, 'QUIZ ON!' (kwee-SOHN): how long is the roast's COOKING time?

items.label: la bouillabaisse
items.scene: A fisherwoman cheers 'BOO-YAH!' (boo-yah-BESS) over her big pot of BOUILLABAISSE fish stew while a red crab peeps over the rim.

items.label: la gastronomie
items.scene: A proud old chef carries a tower of fine French dishes and gives himself a thumbs-up: 'GASTRONOMY? that's ME!' (gahs-troh-noh-MEE).

items.label: le préparatif
items.scene: Grandpa chews his pencil between his TEETH (pray-pah-rah-TEEF) as he works down his long list of PARTY PREPARATIONS.

items.label: l'ingrédient
items.scene: Eggs, a sack of flour and a block of butter wait on a GREY slate board: the INGREDIENTS (an-GRAY-dyahn) all sit on the GRAY.

items.label: gastronomique
items.scene: A MEEK little mouse (gahs-troh-noh-MEEK) shyly lifts the silver dome off a tiny GOURMET plate.

items.label: le barbecue
items.scene: Grandma grills a long QUEUE of sausages on her sizzling BARBECUE: bar-buh-QUEUE (bahr-buh-KYOO).
